summary: Micron Technology's labor dispute in Taiwan appears set for resolution after its Taichung union signed a labor-management agreement with the company and withdrew from the mediation session scheduled for October 22. summary: Market expectations for cloud AI demand have generally remained bullish through 2028-2029, with order visibility extending clearly over the next two to three years. The outlook for 2027 is therefore similarly positive.

summary: Infineon Technologies and US-based silicon carbide (SiC) leader Wolfspeed announced on October 15 a new multi-year supply agreement for 8-inch SiC wafers. This deal transitions their existing supply partnership from 6-inch to 8-inch substrate technology, positioning both companies to meet future demand across electric vehicles (EVs), renewable energy systems, and AI data center power infrastructure.

title: Sony keeps chip unit as imaging sensors, TSMC partnership drive strategy
summary: Sony Group will not spin off its semiconductor business, which focuses on image sensors, president and CEO Hiroki Totoki said recently. The group is retaining the unit because its imaging-sensor expertise creates synergies between components and creative production, while a partnership with Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) will support future manufacturing investment.

title: Samsung Display accelerates MPO and inkjet OLED development for laptops and monitors

SDC is currently validating high-resolution fabrication processes using a 7-inch engineering sample for MPO, while evaluating a pilot line for inkjet printing, with initial commercial targets focused on IT panels such as notebooks and desktop monitors.

The two sides signed a labour-management agreement and agreed to withdraw the mediation scheduled for October 22. Micron will continue talks with its Taoyuan union, which has planned a one-day strike for that date.

title: Murata develops world's smallest NTC thermistor, targets 2027 mass production
summary: Japan's Murata Manufacturing has developed the world's smallest NTC thermistor, the 008004 NCU01 series, measuring 0.25mm × 0.125mm. Key suppliers of copper-clad laminates (CCL), copper foil and drill bits are launching capacity expansion plans covering the next 3-4 years.

title: Taiwan PCB output set to top NT$1 trillion as VP touts AI opportunity

Taiwan's PCB industry is expected to generate more than NT$1 trillion in output for the first time in 2026 as AI infrastructure drives demand across the technology supply chain.

title: Qualcomm plans global performance-based layoffs from November
summary: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon told employees in a memo on October 19 that the company will conduct global, performance-based layoffs after completing its annual employee evaluations, with notifications expected to begin in November. The move aims to build a stronger performance culture and address the company's continued failure to meet expectations.
